newsitem.title: USA: Krystal to be acquired for $14.50/shr.
newsitem.headline: Krystal to be acquired for $14.50/shr.

text.p: Krystal Co said Thursday it had agreed to be acquired by Port Royal Holdings Inc for $14.50 cash per share.
Krystal, a fast-food chain founded in 1932, said its board had unanimously approved the deal and recommended acceptance by shareholders.
Port Royal is a closely-held corporation formed by Philip Sanford, senior vice president of Coca-Cola Enterprises Inc, the largest bottler of Coca-Cola Co products.
Sanford, who has advised the bottler of his intention to resign, will become chairman of Krystal when the transaction is completed. Krystal will remain headquartered in Chatanooga.
